description: This file defines interfaces and types related to CEL (Common Expression Language) evaluation within Kubernetes admission plugins, including expression accessors, evaluation results, variable declarations, and evaluators for conditions and mutations.

classes.name: ExpressionAccessor
classes.description: Interface for accessing CEL expressions and their return types.

classes.name: NamedExpressionAccessor
classes.description: Extends ExpressionAccessor with a name for the expression.

classes.name: EvaluationResult
classes.description: Holds the result and metadata of a CEL evaluation, including the result value, expression, elapsed time, and errors.

classes.name: OptionalVariableDeclarations
classes.description: Declares which optional CEL variables are available for an expression, such as params, authorizer, and patch types.

classes.name: ConditionCompiler
classes.description: Interface for compiling CEL conditions into evaluators.

classes.name: OptionalVariableBindings
classes.description: Provides bindings for optional CEL variables like params and authorizer.

classes.name: ConditionEvaluator
classes.description: Interface for evaluating CEL conditions, including input conversion and error reporting.

classes.name: MutatingCompiler
classes.description: Interface for compiling CEL expressions into evaluators that produce mutations.

classes.name: MutatingEvaluator
classes.description: Interface for evaluating CEL expressions that produce mutations, including input conversion and error reporting.

methods.name: ReturnTypes
methods.description: Returns the expected return types of the CEL expression.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with the expression accessor.

methods.name: ForInput
methods.description: Converts CEL-typed values into evaluated values for input, used in condition and mutation evaluation.

methods.name: CompilationErrors
methods.description: Returns a list of errors encountered during compilation of the evaluator.

methods.name: CompileCondition
methods.description: Compiles a list of expressions into a condition evaluator.

methods.name: CompileMutatingEvaluator
methods.description: Compiles an expression into a mutating evaluator.
